# SELF Magazine

> > SELF is a leading women's wellness magazine covering health, fitness, beauty, mental health, and lifestyle advice with expert-backed content.

SELF Magazine provides evidence-based guidance on women's health issues, workout routines, beauty trends, nutrition, and mental wellness. The publication features expert medical advice, product reviews, beginner guides, and personal stories addressing chronic illness, relationships, and self-care.

## Key Topics

- Mental health and anxiety
- Women's health and wellness
- Fitness and workout routines
- Nutrition and healthy eating
- Beauty and skin care
- Chronic illness management
- Sexual health
- Relationships and lifestyle advice
- Product reviews and recommendations
- Beginner-friendly guides
- Meditation and mindfulness
- Home gym equipment
- Peloton fitness platform
- Accutane and dermatology
- Inclusive wellness content

## Main Content Sections

- [SELF Magazine Homepage](https://self.com): Homepage for SELF Magazine featuring women's health, wellness & beauty content
- [Health & Wellness Advice](https://self.com/health): Main health section covering women's wellness, mental health & nutrition
- [Fitness & Workout Tips](https://self.com/fitness): Fitness section with workouts, exercise routines & sports advice
- [Beauty Tips & Product Reviews](https://self.com/beauty): Beauty section covering skin care, hair care, makeup & product reviews
- [Home & Wellness Products](https://self.com/topic/home): Home products section: furniture, organization & wellness gear reviews
- [About SELF](https://self.com/info/about-self): Mission statement and editorial team info for SELF wellness magazine

## Health Conditions Reference

- [Women's Health Conditions A-Z](https://self.com/health-conditions): A-Z directory of women's health conditions with expert medical advice
- [Anxiety Symptoms & Treatments](https://self.com/health-conditions/anxiety): Comprehensive anxiety resource covering symptoms, types & coping strategies

- [Hot Weather Workout Hydration](https://self.com/story/how-to-hydrate-hot-summer-workouts): Hydration guide for hot weather workouts with sports nutrition advice

## Mental Health & Wellness

- [Borderline Personality Disorder Facts](https://self.com/story/borderline-personality-disorder-facts): Educational article on BPD symptoms, diagnosis & misconceptions

- [Return-to-Work Mental Preparation](https://self.com/story/return-to-work-concerns): Mental health guide for COVID-19 return-to-work anxiety and concerns
- [Accutane and Depression Link](https://self.com/story/accutane-and-depression-link): Article examining Accutane/isotretinoin depression risks and side effects
